entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return this useless VeloBand Pulse I bought. I want my money back, now.

I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with the product. I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's not broken, I just don't like it. The whole thing is clunky. I've had it for about a month and I'm done with it. Send me a return label.

Okay, I see. Let me pull up your order. I show you received it 33 days ago. Unfortunately, because the Pulse band is worn directly on the skin, for **hygiene** and **sanitation** reasons, we have a very strict return window on that specific product. I'm afraid at 33 days, it is **too late** to accept a return.

Are you kidding me?! Too late? Your website says 90 days! This is a complete scam. I want to speak to your manager right now. This is unacceptable! I will plaster bad reviews all over the internet about this.
Sir, I understand your frustration, there's no need for that. Please allow me to put you on a brief hold while I double-check the official documentation. One moment.

Thank you for waiting. I've just reviewed our internal knowledge base, and you are absolutely correct. My apologies. It seems I was looking at a product-specific guideline, but our master **policy** clearly states a 90-day return window for all items. I sincerely apologize for my mistake.
Oh. So you're saying I can return it?

Yes, absolutely. Since you are well within the 90-day period, I can process this return for a full refund for you right away. I am generating a prepaid shipping label and sending it to the email address we have on file. Is that okay?
Hmph. Fine. Yes, that's what should have happened in the first place. Send the label.

It has just been sent. You should see it in your inbox within the next few minutes. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives it, a full refund will be issued to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
Again, I do apologize for the initial confusion. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
